GFED_regional_dm_rho_scaled.csv - provenance
created: 2026-10-22 13:53 CEST
generator: github.com/mscrawford/Fire-Emissions, rho/run_rho.R at c73b9534d6ad666cf15aeae395377c761619a5c5 
units: kg DM per m2 of class area per year; PEAT per m2 of peatland; DEFO_largeFires per m2 of
       tree cover lost to land use per year
definition: rho(p, r) = mean annual GFED4.1s DM mass of partition p in H12 region r
            / historical area of the class p is applied to, over the same years
denominators (historical data, not a model run):
  BORF, TEMF, DEFO_smallFires: forest = primforest + secdforest + forestry
  SAVA: past + range + primother + secdother; AGRI: crop
    (these from LanduseInitialisation, avl_land_full_t_0.5.mz: 1995-2015 interpolated linearly
     to annual values, constant after 2015, period mean)
  PEAT: total peatland, all categories (intact, crop, past, forestry, peatExtract) of MAgPIE's
    peatland input f58_peatland_area_0.5.mz (static)
  DEFO_largeFires: GFW tree cover loss (UMD/Hansen, 30% canopy; gadm__tcl__iso_change v20260424)
    for land use: the drivers Permanent agriculture, Hard commodities, Settlements & Infrastructure
    and Shifting cultivation of the WRI/Google DeepMind driver map v1.13 (Sims et al. 2025, ERL 20,
    074027); mean annual loss over the period; countries to H12 with madrat's regionmappingH12.csv
    (share of the land-use loss in unmapped countries: 0.000493, XAD XKO Z01 Z06 Z07 ZNC)
  gridded classes: 0.5 deg cells to H12 through the clustermap
period: 2003-2016
DEFO_largeFires: 0 below 0.01 Mha/yr land-use loss; capped at 20.3 kg DM/m2 (capped: none ; below the threshold: JPN, MEA, NEU )
no floor: regions below the threshold get DEFO_largeFires = 0, also outside the tropics
no fallback: regions without GFED DEFO small-fire mass get DEFO_smallFires = 0
R: R version 4.3.2 (2023-10-31)
